Title: Shakar : the Hunt & Provision of the Silsila

Messages.Author: Charos
Messages.Body:
Hi!

Question about these cards.

1 : I have black hand assamite in game, and play shakar the hunt, does provision of silsila work if i torpor vampire chosen for shakar, as provision talks about naming not chosen for contract.
2. do i have time to play provision when opposing vampire leaves the play. As provision says : only usable if the opposing minion is not ready. And shakar says burn this card when minion leaves the ready region. So are both played in same phase, and i can choose card played first or not.

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body:

>

> Put this card on a ready minion. Every Black Hand vampire is considered chosen for this contract. Any Black Hand vampire can enter combat with this minon as a +1 stealth  action. Burn this card when this minion leaves the ready region.
> Artist: Javier Santos
>
> Name: Provision of the Silsila
> [FN:R2, LotN:PA]
> Cardtype: Action Modifier/Reaction
> Clan: Assamite
> Usable by a tapped vampire.
> Only usable after a combat involving this Assamite and a minion with a contract naming this Assamite. Only usable if the opposing minion is not ready and this Assamite is ready. This Assamite gains enough blood from the blood bank to reach full capacity, and the contract is burned if still in play.
> Artist: Mike Danza

I'd say yes. Provision can be played. During the combat (as Provision states) there was contract in place, and now the opposing the minion is no longer ready. But I am not Floppy.

I think the answer is yes to both questions. I think naming and chosen mean the same thing. the being ready thing and burning the card, I think you can play both effects at the same time.

Messages.Author: TryDeflectingThisGrapple
Messages.Body:
I'm not so sure - for 2 reasons. The issue isn't "naming" vs "chosen" which works just fine. It's card text on Shakar and combat timing.

First (nitpicky). Being "considered chosed" opposed to "chosen."

The presence of that word on both Shakar: the Hunt and Haqim's Law: Judgement suggests that all minions aren't actually chosen, or the card would be more simply worded with "are chosen for."

So your Assamite might not be able to play cards that require being named/chosen. It's kinda like "as is he had the discipline required" on Inceptor isn't really having the discipline.

Second (pretty sure this keeps you from playing PotS).

As soon as the minion opposing your Assamite goes to torpor, the Shakar: the Hunt burns ("when" in card text). From there combat proceeds to end of round, then end of combat.

AFTER combat, you try to play the PotS as an action modifier/reaction....but the requisite contract is no longer available on the opposing minion (having burned IN combat) - so the play is invalid.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
"Chosen", "considered chosen" or "naming this Assamite" are the same when it relates to contracts.
The wording is wrong on Provision of the Silsila, even though it's no big deal (no other contract card in play uses the term "naming", meaning that Provision wouldn't be usable at all if there were some kind of difference)

For question 2, correct answer and link have been given.
